name: Yongzhen Li
bio: Yongzhen received his bachelor degree in Bioinformatics at Huazhong Agricultural University, China. Now he is a student doing the Master of Information Technology program at the University of Auckland since he is interested in the latest technology. He plans to be a mobile application developer or game developer in the future. Yongzhen is now working on Real-time Emotion Detection project with Suranga. He loves sports and basketball is his favourite. He enjoys playing computer games as well in his spare time.
